title: Nouns and agreement
intro: Informations, advices, 'one of my friend' — these small slips make English sound foreign. Master the noun rules and agreement once.
introBn: ছোট ভুলগুলো ঠিক করলেই ইংরেজি পরিষ্কার শোনায়।

units.title: Countable and uncountable
units.idea: Some nouns cannot be counted in English even if they can in Bangla: information, advice, news, furniture, equipment, feedback, luggage. No plural -s, no a/an.
units.ideaBn: information, advice, news, feedback, luggage — এগুলো কখনো s নেয় না, a/an-ও নয়।

formula.name: Uncountable
formula.pos: some information · a piece of advice · much feedback · little time

formula.name: Countable
formula.pos: a suggestion · two tips · many complaints · few options

uses.rule: To count them: a piece of, an item of, a bit of.
uses.ex: Let me give you a piece of advice.

uses.rule: much / little with uncountable; many / few with countable.
uses.ex: How much luggage? How many bags?

traps.wrong: Can you give me some informations?
traps.right: Can you give me some information?
He gave me some advice / a piece of advice.

drills.s: Thank you for your ___ on the draft.
We need new ___ for the lab.

o: She gave me many useful advices.
She gave me a lot of useful advice.
She gave me an useful advice.
She gave me many useful advice.
drills.a: She gave me a lot of useful advice.
drills.x: Advice is uncountable; a lot of works for both.

drills.q: আমার কাছে খুব অল্প সময় আছে।

drills.x: Countable plural: fewer (less is common in speech, but fewer is correct).

drills.s: I have a lot of ___ to do today.

units.title: Subject–verb agreement
units.idea: The verb agrees with the real subject, not the nearest noun. Watch out for 'one of', 'each', 'everyone', long subjects and 'there is/are'.
units.ideaBn: verb আসল subject-এর সাথে মিলবে, পাশের noun-এর সাথে নয়।

formula.name: Singular
formula.pos: Everyone is · Each employee has · One of my friends lives

formula.name: Plural
formula.pos: Both are · A number of people have · There are two issues

uses.rule: One of + plural noun + singular verb.
uses.ex: One of our clients is unhappy.

uses.rule: Find the head noun in long subjects.
uses.ex: The list of new products is ready.

uses.rule: There is + singular, there are + plural.

traps.wrong: One of my colleague are sick.
traps.right: One of my colleagues is sick.
traps.bn: one of এর পরে plural noun, verb একবচন।

drills.s: Everyone in the team ___ the new policy.
One of the printers ___ not working.
The quality of the products ___ improved.

o: There is two issues we need to fix.
There are two issues we need to fix.
There have two issues we need to fix.
It has two issues we need to fix.
drills.a: There are two issues we need to fix.

drills.s: Each of the managers ___ a parking space.

o: One of my friends lives in Canada.
One of my friend lives in Canada.
One of my friends live in Canada.
My one friend live in Canada.
drills.a: One of my friends lives in Canada.

drills.s: A number of employees ___ asked for remote work.
The number of employees ___ grown this year.

mastery.s: Please send me more ___ about the course.

mastery.x: Neither of: singular in formal English.

o: The furnitures in the office is new.
The furniture in the office is new.
The furniture in the office are new.
The furnitures in the office are new.
mastery.a: The furniture in the office is new.

mastery.q: প্রত্যেক কর্মী একটা আইডি কার্ড পায়।
o: Every employee gets an ID card.
Every employees get an ID card.
Every employee get a ID card.
All employee gets an ID card.
mastery.a: Every employee gets an ID card.
mastery.x: Every + singular + singular verb; an ID (vowel sound).

mastery.s: There ___ a lot of traffic this morning.
